capability.hwAccelOk: This browser supports WebCodecs decode/encode and H.264 output. Compression will request hardware acceleration; actual hardware usage depends on the browser and system. Usually faster with lower CPU and power consumption.
capability.hwAccelBad: This browser lacks the required APIs for local compression, input decoding, or H.264 encoding. Compression may fail or fall back to software paths. Usually slower with higher CPU and power consumption.
capability.hwAccelDetecting: Detecting local encode/decode capabilities of this browser.
capability.webCodecsWarning: This browser lacks WebCodecs and cannot perform local compression.
capability.webGpuWarning: WebGPU is unavailable; will use Mediabunny/WebCodecs feasible path with degradation flag.
capability.hdrWarning: HDR source detected; output colors may not match expectations.
capability.h264_1080p60_Warning: 1080p60 H.264 encoding is unavailable; fallback to 1080p30 recommended.
capability.h264None: H.264 MP4 encoding is unavailable. Please use the latest desktop Chrome/Edge.

input.title: Input Video
input.description: Supports MP4 / MOV. Source video info is read automatically after selection.
input.probing: Reading container, tracks, and browser capabilities.
input.idleHint: Container, track, and codec info shown after selecting a video.
input.dropZone: Drag video here, or click to select

output.title: Output Settings
output.description: Pick a quality preset first, then fine-tune resolution, frame rate, and bitrate.

quality.label: High
quality.detail: High preset increases video and audio bitrates, better for motion-heavy footage or re-editing.

upload.label: Medium
upload.detail: Medium preset balances quality and file size, suitable for regular upload and sharing.

small.label: Low
small.detail: Low preset prioritizes small file size, suitable for chat sharing or quick preview.

custom.label: Custom
custom.detail: Custom preset allows manual video and audio bitrate settings. Resolution and frame rate can be customized separately in their groups.

dialog.runningTaskDesc: Leaving, navigating back, or switching files will interrupt the ongoing compression task. Once confirmed, the current task cannot be recovered.
dialog.completedTaskDesc: Starting a new task will clear the current output and download entry. Please ensure you have downloaded or no longer need this result.

job.completedToast: Compression complete, output file ready for download
job.workerFailedSuggestion: Please refresh the page and try again, or use the latest desktop Chrome/Edge.
job.cancelledMessage: The current compression task has been stopped.
job.cancelledSuggestion: You can adjust parameters and start again.
job.unsupportedSuggestion: Please use MP4/MOV with H.264 or HEVC video and AAC audio.
job.encodeSuggestion: Please use the latest desktop Chrome/Edge, or lower to 1080p30 and retry.
job.decodeSuggestion: If the source is HEVC/HDR/MOV, please convert to SDR H.264 MP4 first.
job.memorySuggestion: Try shorter clips, 1080p30, lower bitrate, or close other memory-heavy tabs.
job.defaultSuggestion: Please use the latest desktop Chrome/Edge, or select lower frame rate and bitrate and retry.
